notes: Seed pack from capability-gap categories (math, cite-search, fetch/extract, pptx/xlsx, github list, time/Dublin, research-deep, blank-survival). Drop Grok-harvested hard prompts into harvested[] (set enabled true) or append to seeds[]. Detectors score breakage, not answer quality.

seeds.prompt: Say hello in one short sentence.
seeds.notes: Guest/first-send must not vanish into a blank transcript after send.

seeds.prompt: A jacket costs $120. After a 15% discount and then 8% sales tax on the discounted price, what is the final price? Show the arithmetic.
What is 17 × 23? Reply with the product and a one-line check.
What is Ireland's latest published unemployment rate? Use web search, cite sources with inline [1] [2], and list the URLs.
Fetch https://example.com and extract the page title plus the first sentence of the body. Quote them.
Research Dublin junior investment-ops market Sep 2026 and give me a real .pptx.
seeds.notes: Playbook eval prompt — breakage probe, not a quality rubric.

seeds.prompt: Make a real .xlsx of Q3 costs with headers Category, Amount, Notes and three sample rows.
List the top-level files in https://github.com/joelntemuse24/aether- using GitHub list tools (do not scrape the HTML page).
seeds.notes: Without a GitHub connector the honest answer is 'not connected' — that is not a probe failure. Crash / blank / DSML is.

seeds.prompt: What time is it in Dublin, Ireland right now? Include the timezone name.
seeds.notes: Known Expert failure: ZoneInfoNotFoundError and raw DSML tool_search dumps.

seeds.prompt: Compare two current approaches to fund administration in Dublin. Use web search, then write a short sourced brief with inline [1] [2] citations.
